summary: An AI news anchor introduces the SpeakEasy App, which helps users practice speaking English through Hindi explanations. The app features short, real-life lessons and a personal AI teacher that corrects mistakes without judgment. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app and start speaking fluent English.
